rain_expected_delay_irrigation: Rain is forecast in the next 2 days. Consider delaying irrigation.
heavy_rainfall_risk: Heavy rainfall is forecast. Check drainage and avoid field operations on waterlogged soil. This is an estimate, not a guarantee.
heat_stress_risk: Very hot days are forecast. Watch crops for wilting and check soil moisture.
dry_spell_recent: Little or no rain has fallen recently. Check soil moisture and consider irrigation where available.
dry_spell_forecast: A dry period is forecast. Check soil moisture and consider irrigation where available.
high_water_demand_check_moisture: Crop water demand is high and little rain is forecast. Check soil moisture more often.
